non_goals: Do not give any of the three paths a caller identity it is not
Do not advance a Requirement for a reason the pass did not observe
Do not construct the completion proof anywhere other than the promotion path that earns it
Do not complete a Requirement on the strength of an Increment succeeding
Do not treat a fake journey as evidence about the real one
Do not make any of the three unbounded in order to reach every Requirement
